name: publicWeb_getSong
description: Returns a single song for the song detail page, scoped to a kennel via HC.KennelSongMap. The KennelSongMap join prevents cross-kennel access — a caller cannot read another kennel's songs by guessing song IDs. Returns an empty rowset when the song is not found or not assigned to the kennel. No authentication required.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Public GUID of the kennel — used to scope the song lookup

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Internal GUID of the song to fetch

rowsets.name: SongDetail
rowsets.description: Zero or one row. Zero rows means song not found, not assigned to this kennel, or kennel not found. On validation error the standard Success/ErrorMessage envelope is returned instead.

columns.name: TuneOf
columns.description: Tune this song is sung to

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from the rowset
Never change the zero-row = not found contract — Next.js callers check for empty array
